request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material, skin and fabric texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must read the number instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

This is a precise edit of image 1: the result must look like the same photograph with one detail changed. Change only what the instruction names.

Image 1 shows a grandmother at a table behind a birthday cake with two blue numeral candles that read 60. Keep the photograph exactly as it is: the same woman, clothes, table, cake, room, light and framing. Change ONLY the left candle: the 6 becomes an 8 of the same blue color, size and style, lit and upright, so that the two candles read 80. The right candle stays a 0. Nothing else changes.
